Method of Attack: Encrypts files using AES encryption with a key generated from a seed that can be attacked to create a decryptor
Uses a UAC bypass called Eleven (Elevation by environment variable expansion) to delete Shadow Volume Copies and backup files
Deletes shadow volume copies and backup images to prevent file restoration
Copies itself to C:\Users\Public\Reload.exe and executes a batch file system_.bat to delete the original installer
Scans local and unmapped network shares for targeted file extensions to encrypt
Creates ransom note DECRYPT_INFORMATION.html and UNIQUE_ID_DO_NOT_REMOVE file containing encrypted AES key
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (local and unmapped network shares)
Attack Vector: Execution of ransomware executable, UAC bypass via VBS and batch files to gain elevated privileges and delete backups
Indicators of Compromise: File marker 'HERMES' appended to encrypted files
